description:
On the /credits page, imagery from CMSA (China Manned Space Agency), USAF (United States Air Force), and SpaceIL scatters across the Wikimedia Commons and Solar System Scope sections instead of appearing under their proper section headers.

Expected: Each provenance entry is grouped under the section header that matches its true producing organization, as declared in the `agency` field of image-provenance.json. CMSA entries appear under the CNSA section, USAF entries under the U.S. Space Force section, and SpaceIL entries under a dedicated SpaceIL section.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='CMSA' (case-insensitive) appears under the 'China National Space Administration' section header on /credits (source-logos id 'cnsa'). [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should CMSA entries route to?' A: 'Route to the existing 'cnsa' id — CMSA operates under CNSA.']
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='USAF' (case-insensitive) appears under the 'U.S. Space Force' section header on /credits (source-logos id 'us-space-force'). [reporter: Q: 'Should USAF route to the existing 'us-space-force' source-logos section, or get its own 'united-states-air-force' section?' A: 'Route to the existing 'us-space-force' section — USAF folds into the US military space section.']
- Every image-provenance entry with agency='SpaceIL' (case-insensitive) appears under a new 'SpaceIL' section header on /credits (source-logos id 'spaceil'). [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should 'SpaceIL' entries route to?' A: 'It needs its own — the intended section id is 'spaceil'.']
- Image-provenance entries with agency='MBRSC (UAE Space Agency)' continue to appear under the 'MBRSC / UAE Space Agency' section header on /credits (source-logos id 'uaesa'). [reporter: Q: 'Should MBRSC route to its own 'mbrsc' source-logos section, or stay under 'uaesa'?' A: 'Stays under the existing 'uaesa' section.']
- The single image-provenance entry with agency='CFHT' stays under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section header on /credits. [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should CFHT entries route to?' A: 'Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section — do not create a new section for it.']
- The single image-provenance entry with agency='EHT' stays under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section header on /credits. [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should EHT entries route to?' A: 'Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section — do not create a new section for it.']
- Image-provenance entries with agency='Multi-agency' stay under the 'Wikimedia Commons contributors' section header on /credits. [reporter: Q: 'What source-logos id should 'Multi-agency' entries route to?' A: 'Stays under the Wikimedia Commons section — do not create a new section for it.']
- No image-provenance entry with agency='CMSA' falls through to the Wikimedia Commons or Solar System Scope fallback. [code-invariant: The routing fallback chain in provenanceSourceId() drops unmapped agency strings through SOURCE_TYPE_TO_ID (wikimedia-commons / solar-system-scope). After fixing, agencyToSourceId must intercept 'cmsa' before the fallback fires.]
- No image-provenance entry with agency='USAF' falls through to the Wikimedia Commons fallback. [code-invariant: Same fallback chain. After fixing, agencyToSourceId must intercept 'usaf' before it drops through.]
- No image-provenance entry with agency='SpaceIL' falls through to the Wikimedia Commons or Solar System Scope fallback. [code-invariant: Same fallback chain. After fixing, agencyToSourceId must intercept 'spaceil' before it drops through.]

Domain facts:
- CMSA (China Manned Space Agency) is a sub-organization operating under the CNSA umbrella — its imagery belongs under the CNSA section.
- US Air Force space activities (X-37B, GPS, etc.) are distinct from the U.S. Space Force but fold into the same /credits section per the maintainer's editorial decision.
- SpaceIL is a standalone Israeli non-profit — requires its own section with a distinct source-logos entry.
- MBRSC entries already route correctly to 'uaesa' (the a.includes('mbrsc') check catches 'MBRSC (UAE Space Agency)').
- CFHT (1 entry), EHT (1 entry), and Multi-agency (42 entries) all correctly fall through to wikimedia-commons as intended.
